errata.notes: All references named [IANA] should be replaced by [IANA-protocols] because such references refer to the list of current assignments, that are placed at the location, mentioned as [IANA-protocols].
This errata report is to remove confusion made by Errata ID 2733.  That errata proposes that [IANA] shall be replaced by [IANA-protocols] and no references to [IANA] are therefore needed.
